pages: They came at night, breaking the doors of our homes and dragging us into the night. They were our neighbors... our friends and family. I couldn't believe what He has done to them.
A man - they called him Robert - took my brother first. I heard the lever pull and the trapdoors open. I couldn't look up. I just couldn't...
The men of my village are whispering. They want to ambush the guards while they are distracted...
Robert looked at me. I am next...
